skills.name: Sword Spike
skills.description:
Gusion throws a dagger in the target direction, dealing 200<font color='#27C0C7'>( +50% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> to the first enemy hit and marking them.
<font color='#404495'>(Use Again)</font>: Gusion moves behind the marked enemy, dealing 200<font color='#27C0C7'>( +100% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> to them. This skill cannot be interrupted while Gusion is moving behind the marked enemy.
skills.tips: Using Sword Spike after using Incandescence when near the target will greatly increase its hit rate.

skills.name: Shadowblade Slaughter
skills.description:
Gusion throws a volley of daggers in the target direction, each dealing 100<font color='#27C0C7'>( +40% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> to enemies hit and slowing them by 6% for 2s (when hit by multiple daggers, the slow effect can stack up to 30%).
<font color='#404495'>(Use Again)</font>: Gusion recalls the daggers, each dealing 65<font color='#27C0C7'>( +40% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> to enemies in its path.
skills.tips: After using Incandescence, you can use this skill again immediately and recover 10 daggers, dealing high damage.

skills.name: Incandescence
skills.description:
Gusion dashes to the target location, resetting the cooldown of <font color='#404495'>(Sword Spike)</font> and <font color='#404495'>(Shadowblade Slaughter)</font>. If <font color='#404495'>(Shadowblade Slaughter)</font> was cast once before the reset, Gusion can throw another five daggers on his next <font color='#404495'>(Shadowblade Slaughter)</font> cast, and recall a total of ten daggers afterward.
<font color='#404495'>(Use Again)</font>: Gusion dashes a short distance in the target direction.
skills.tips: Incandescence's second cast can not only be used to escape, but can also be used to get closer to a fleeing target and finish them off.

skills.name: Dagger Specialist
skills.description: Each skill cast adds a rune to Gusion's dagger (stacks up to 4 times). Each stack enhances Gusion's next Basic Attack to deal additional damage equal to 3% of the target's lost HP and restore 50<font color='#27C0C7'>( +25% Total Magic Power)</font> HP to himself.
skills.tips: Because this skill's damage is based on the target's missing HP, it's suitable for finishing off enemies.

items.name: Starlium Scythe
items.des: Unique Passive - Crisis: Within 3s after casting a skill, the caster's next Basic Attack will deal additional True Damage equal to 100 plus 100% Magic Power and briefly grant 10% Movement Speed. This effect has a 1.5s cooldown.

items.name: Ice Hunter's Magic Boots
items.des: Unique Passive - Hunter: After dealing damage to a Creep, deal 25<2|lv 3> + <1005 0.01> True Damage to the target over 3s (damage is increased by 100% for non-Marksmen heroes).

items.name: Holy Crystal
items.des: Unique Passive - Mystery: Gains 21%-35% extra Magic Power (scales with level).

items.name: Concentrated Energy
items.des: Unique Passive - Recharge: Increases Magic Power by 5 after dealing Magic Damage (this effect stacks up to 6 times and can only gain 1 stack every 0.4s). When reaching full stacks, increases Magic Damage by 12% for 3s.

items.name: Fleeting Time
items.des: Unique Passive - Timestream: Hero kills or assists reduce the Ultimate's current cooldown by 30%.

items.name: Divine Glaive
items.des: Unique Passive - Spellbreaker: When attacking an enemy, gains 0.1% extra Magic Penetration for each point of the enemy's Magic Defense, capped at 20%.

builds.tips: Smooth Jungling, Skill Damage Focus When going for a jungler build, maximize your jungling speed to reach level 4 as soon as possible and start ganking. In the early game, grab a Concentrated Energy to supplement your HP and spell vamp, and ensure the viability of your skills while maintaining your sustainability through your passive's healing effect and your spell vamp. After this, get a Fleeting Time to increase the frequency at which you can gank, then finally, you can buy a Lightning Truncheon and Blood Wings to boost your burst damage.
